email.subject1: a signal play for Total Therapy
email.body1:
Robert, with ABA demand climbing past $7.9B this year, providers like Total Therapy are under real pressure to grow referral and partner pipeline fast.

That growth usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that gap is where opportunities go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Total Therapy off your market and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Robert, quick follow-up for Total Therapy.

In a market growing this fast, the pipeline target usually outpaces what headcount can cover. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Total Therapy needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Robert, last bit of proof for Total Therapy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Total Therapy's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Robert, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Growing a care organization is its own kind of busy, and timing matters more than anything here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Total Therapy either way.
